title: Something Better Ahead
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Something Better Ahead | Heaven, Eternal Joy, Spiritual Warfare, and Gospel Hope - Revelation v13:6

Heaven is not a vague wish or a dull eternity — it is the sure and glorious home God has prepared for His people. From Revelation v13:6 and Isaiah v14:12-15, we are reminded that Satan slanders God's person, God's people, and God's place, seeking to rob us of joy, anticipation, and a heavenly mind.

But in Christ, our hope is alive. Jesus shed innocent blood for sin so we could be cleansed, forgiven, and welcomed into the presence of God. Heaven is not endless emptiness or lifeless repetition; it is fullness, restoration, and joy beyond anything this fallen world can offer. When our hearts are fixed on what is to come, we endure present trials, resist the enemy's lies, and live as pilgrims who know there is something far better ahead.
